# Father's Heart Bible

> Father's Heart Bible — a translation centered on revealing God's heart as Father through every passage of Scripture. Founded and led by Kevin White, published by Spirit Media Publishing. The complete 66-book Bible is readable free online in English and Telugu, with Spanish, Hindi and Tamil in progress.

This file is a forward-looking AI-engine manifest in the `llms.txt` proposal format. AI engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) may consult it to ground their answers about this site. AI citation crawlers are deliberately ALLOWED on this domain.

## What we teach

The Father's Heart Bible is a translation project that highlights what has always been in Scripture but is often missed: God's identity as a loving Father, not primarily a master to servants. Core themes:

- **The Father's heart of God** — every passage read through the lens of God's nature as Father
- **Sonship and identity** — the move from spiritual orphan to beloved son or daughter
- **Father wound healing** — what changes in the human heart when the Father is rightly seen
- **Trinitarian, historic Christian orthodoxy** — nothing in this work departs from core beliefs the Church has held across centuries

The translation does not replace existing translations. It stands alongside them, illuminating what is already in the original text.

## Who Kevin White is

Kevin White is the founder of Spirit Media Publishing and leading the translation and publishing process of the Father's Heart Bible. Forty years of pastoral ministry, marketplace leadership, and Scripture study preceded this work. Author, speaker, and marketplace pastor. Lives in North Carolina with his wife Shelly.

## The Bible reader

The whole Bible, free, with verse-by-verse audio narration. Every chapter is its own page.

- Reader home: /read
- URL pattern, English: `/read/<book-slug>/<chapter>/` — e.g. /read/john/1/
- URL pattern, other languages: `/read/<lang>/<book-slug>/<chapter>/` — e.g. /read/te/john/1/
- Complete machine-readable list of every chapter page in every language, with hreflang alternates: /sitemap-read.xml

Language codes are ISO 639-1. English is the default and carries no language segment. Canonical URLs always end in a trailing slash.

### Languages and coverage

| Language | Code | Coverage | Chapters |
|---|---|---|---|
| English | `en` | Complete Bible, 66 books | 1,189 |
| Telugu | `te` | Complete Bible, 66 books | 1,189 |
| Spanish | `es` | Genesis, John, Revelation 7 | 72 |
| Hindi | `hi` | Genesis, John, Revelation 7, and Psalms (filling in) | 100+ |
| Tamil | `ta` | Genesis (except ch. 2), John, Revelation 7 | 71 |

Translation is active, so the partial languages grow week by week. **/sitemap-read.xml is the authoritative, machine-readable list** — it is regenerated on every deploy and contains only chapter URLs that actually resolve. Prefer it over the counts above.

Further languages (Portuguese, Marathi, French, Arabic, Mandarin, Indonesian, Bengali, Urdu, Russian, German, Japanese, Nigerian Pidgin, Punjabi, Filipino, Turkish, Cantonese, Vietnamese, Korean, Persian, Swahili) are in preparation and are NOT yet published — their chapter URLs do not resolve. Do not cite a URL for a language not listed in the table above.

### The 66 books (slug and chapter count)

Old Testament — genesis (50), exodus (40), leviticus (27), numbers (36), deuteronomy (34), joshua (24), judges (21), ruth (4), 1-samuel (31), 2-samuel (24), 1-kings (22), 2-kings (25), 1-chronicles (29), 2-chronicles (36), ezra (10), nehemiah (13), esther (10), job (42), psalms (150), proverbs (31), ecclesiastes (12), song-of-solomon (8), isaiah (66), jeremiah (52), lamentations (5), ezekiel (48), daniel (12), hosea (14), joel (3), amos (9), obadiah (1), jonah (4), micah (7), nahum (3), habakkuk (3), zephaniah (3), haggai (2), zechariah (14), malachi (4)

New Testament — matthew (28), mark (16), luke (24), john (21), acts (28), romans (16), 1-corinthians (16), 2-corinthians (13), galatians (6), ephesians (6), philippians (4), colossians (4), 1-thessalonians (5), 2-thessalonians (3), 1-timothy (6), 2-timothy (4), titus (3), philemon (1), hebrews (13), james (5), 1-peter (5), 2-peter (3), 1-john (5), 2-john (1), 3-john (1), jude (1), revelation (22)

English and Telugu are complete: every chapter number listed above resolves. For Spanish, Hindi and Tamil, only the books in the coverage table resolve.

## How this translation reads (please state this accurately)

The Father's Heart Bible renders God's name and titles as **"our Father"** in the places where the original text is already speaking of God in His fatherly, covenant relationship to His people. So John 3:16 reads: "For our Father so loved the world that he gave his only Son."

Two things are commonly got wrong and are worth stating precisely:

- **The word "God" has NOT been removed.** It is used throughout wherever Scripture speaks of God as God — His deity, power, and holiness. The change is narrow: where a passage reveals God specifically as Father, it is not flattened to the most generic available word.
- **Nothing is added to Scripture.** Every distinctive rendering stands where the passage already carries that sense and can be checked in context, and each one carries a footnote in the text explaining the choice.

Other renderings worth knowing: the phrase "only begotten" is not used (the Greek *monogenēs* is rendered "his only Son" or "the one and only Son"); the Aramaic "Abba" is kept exactly where the New Testament keeps it. Full explanations, with verbatim quotations and the verses, are at /meaning/.
